fact: Lake Arrowhead's covenants send only three kinds of plans to the Architectural Control Committee (new homes; outbuildings, garages, barns, carports or similar structures; and corrals or other animal enclosures) and never mention lawns, landscaping, artificial turf or putting greens.
quote: No structure shall be built or moved upon any lot in Lake Arrowhead until that building or structure has been reviewed and approved by the Architectural Control Committee. The majority if the Architectural Control Committee or its designate shall review and approve or reject and shall be reviewed only on these following criteria: All plans for new homes or dwellings to be constructed within Lake Arrowhead. All plans for construction or moving of outbuildings, garages, barns, dwellings, or carports or similar structures on any lot. All plans for construction of corrals or similar animal confinements or enclosures on any lot. The Architectural Control Committee shall review items 1 through 3 according to the following general criteria, and only the following criteria
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)
notes: Full text read 2026-09-26 (converted from the posted .doc). The words turf, lawn, landscape, landscaping and putting green do not appear; the only plant words are "hedge", "weeds", "grass clippings", "tree branches" and "vegetation" (bridle-path mowing). The criteria for items 1-3 are floor area, Weld County building-code compliance and exterior finish, and for corrals sturdy construction.

fact: The Lake Arrowhead Architectural Control Committee has two elected association members and one representative named by the developer, whose seat passes to another elected member once the developer's last lot is sold; it accepts plans at any time and must decide within seven calendar days of receiving them.
quote: There is hereby established an Architectural Control Committee consisting of two elected members of the Association and one representative named by the developer of Lake Arrowhead. … At the time that the final lot held by the develop is sold for the first time, the developer’s representative shall relinquish his place on the committee and be repacked by another elected member of the Association. … The Architectural Control Committee will accept plans at any time and will render a decision with seven (7) calendar days after recent of the plans.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: In Lake Arrowhead a variance from the covenants needs written approval from both the Architectural Control Committee and the adjacent owners, acted on within seven calendar days, and any fence, wall or hedge over six feet needs the adjacent owners' written approval.
quote: A variance to the specific restrictions set forth under this section may be granted to a property owner provided that the request for a variance is submitted in writing to the Architectural Control Committee and approved in writing by the Committee or its designate AND the owners of property adjacent to the property on which the variance is requested. … The Committee or its designate will act upon such requests within seven (7) calendar days of receipt of the request. No fence, wall or hedge may be higher than six (6) feet above ground level unless written approval is obtained from the property owners adjacent thereto.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: Lake Arrowhead's covenants bar any building, outbuilding or fence over a bridle-path easement and any storage on one, and have the association police the easements for trash and mow their vegetation to 3 to 6 inches at least once a year.
quote: In no event shall any portion of any building or outbuilding or fence be erected over a bridle path easement. No storage is permitted on bridle path easements. … Easements for utilities and maintenance of utilities and bridle paths are reserved as shown on the recorded plat. The Association shall cause the bridle path easements to maintained in that at least once each calendar year such easements shall be policed for trash and the vegetation mowed to a level of 3 - 6 inches. Associated structures in an easement or bridle path such as a foot bridge over an irrigation ditch will be maintained by the Association.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: A Lake Arrowhead fence along a bridle-path easement, built after the house, must be wood or steel pipe, five feet tall, with posts on eight-foot centers and at least two rails, must run the easement's full length on the lot, and may not use barbed wire.
quote: Bridle path fencing that may be erected (including fences as part of a corral or animal confinement) upon any lot after completion of any dwelling thereon seal be of wood or steel pipe, five (5) feet in height, constructed with posts set on eight (8) foot centers, and of no less than a two rail design including the top rail. Barbed wire, concertina wire or fences of similar materials shall be prohibited. Said fence shall extend the entire length of the boundary of any easement traversing the lot and which is reserved for bridle path purposes.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: Lake Arrowhead's covenants keep buildings and accessory structures 40 feet from the front lot line and 20 feet from a side street, dwellings and attached garages 20 feet from interior side lines, and any structure 10 feet from the rear line, allow one residence per site and bar splitting a lot.
quote: No portion of any building or accessory structure thereto shall be located 40 feet to the front lot line, or nearer than 20 feet to any side street line. In the case of corner lots, the narrow side shall always be considered the front of the lot. No portion of any dwelling or attached garage or carport shall be located nearer than 20 feet to any interior side lot line. No portion of any structure shall be located any nearer than ten (10) feet to the rear lot line, and no more than one residence may be constructed on any one site. … No lot as platted shall be subdivide for the purpose of making two or more lots.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: Each Lake Arrowhead lot may keep up to four large animals such as horses or cattle, and drainage from a corral area must not run onto adjacent properties or bridle paths.
quote: Not more than four (4) large animals (horses, cattle, or animals of similar size) may be maintained on any one lot. … Natural drainage associated with any coral area shall be altered and so maintained that such drainage shall not drain onto other adjacent properties or adjacent bridle paths.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: Lake Arrowhead's covenants allow building material to be stored on a lot for more than 30 days only during construction of a dwelling or other improvements, and bar using a lot or easement to store or dump trash, grass clippings or branches, apart from a compost pile for use on that lot.
quote: No lot may be used for storage, warehousing or stockpiling of lumber or any other type of building material in excess of thirty (30) days for any purpose except during the construction a dwelling or other improvements. … No lot or easement shall be used for storage or disposal of trash, grass clippings, tree branches or similar items, except that the owner of a lot may maintain a compost pile for use exclusively on that lot. All lots shall be maintained in a clean and sanitary manner.
source_label: Covenants for Lake Arrowhead Subdivision, July 2019 version (posted on the HOA documents page April 7, 2026)

fact: The Lake Arrowhead HOA documents page posts the covenants and bylaws (both July 2019 versions), the water association's rules, dues information and a dumpster restriction list, and no separate architectural or landscape guidelines.
quote: Community Documents … Restricted items list.pdf … Dues Information.docx … How to order Blue Address Signs.docx … RESERVE TABLES & CHAIRS.docx … Water Assoc RULES.docx … LAHA Covenants July 2019.doc … LAHA Bylaws July 2019.doc
source_label: Lake Arrowhead HOA, Community Documents page (rendered and read September 26, 2026)
notes: The bylaws (July 2019) set up the board and dues and do not mention the Architectural Control Committee or landscaping. The "Restricted items list" is a roll-off dumpster restriction list. The page's document list, read 2026-09-26, also holds a logo image uploaded 2026-09-23.

fact: The Lake Arrowhead HOA describes the neighborhood as unincorporated Weld County between Evans and Greeley, with every home on one acre or more and bridle paths running through it, and calls it a Greeley community with a Greeley 80634 address.
quote: A Proud Community of Greeley, Colorado … Lake Arrowhead is located in unincorporated Weld County, nestled between Evans and Greeley in Northern Colorado. Each home sits on one acre or more, offering spacious open lots, quiet streets, and scenic bridle paths that wind throughout the neighborhood … Lake Arrowhead HOA — Greeley, CO 80634
source_label: Lake Arrowhead Homeowners Association website, home page (read September 26, 2026)
notes: The home page is a single-page app; the live hero subtext, intro paragraph and contact address were read from the site's own public content (site_settings) on 2026-09-26.

fact: The Lake Arrowhead Water Association, which is not part of the HOA, limits the reservoir to members in good standing, in daylight hours, with electric trolling motors only, and says it has no taps available for new members.
quote: The L.A.W.A. is not part of the Lake Arrowhead Homeowner Association … There are no taps available for new water association members. • Respect private property and your neighbors. • Hours of operation -daylight hours only • No propelled vehicles – except for electric trolling motors • Water member must be in good standing with the L.A.W.A. … April 22, 2026
source_label: Lake Arrowhead Water Association (L.A.W.A.) rules, dated April 22, 2026, posted on the HOA documents page
notes: The sheet names two contacts with phone numbers; left out of the quote on purpose.

fact: The Lake Arrowhead HOA website's own description of the subdivision says it is centered around a man-made lake, with bridle trails and access to Lake Arrowhead Water Association irrigation.
quote: Private residential community in Greeley, Colorado centered around a man-made lake. Single-family homes on larger lots with Rocky Mountain views, bridle trails, and access to Lake Arrowhead Water Association irrigation. Includes First through Fourth Filings.
source_label: Lake Arrowhead Homeowners Association website, home page structured data (Residence description), read September 26, 2026
notes: Read from the page's schema.org JSON-LD. The water association's April 22, 2026 rules say there are no taps available for new members, so access depends on the lot.

fact: Weld County's permit bulletin says no building permit is needed for fences other than pool barriers, retaining walls up to four feet, patios not more than 30 inches above grade, or one-story sheds and playhouses up to 200 square feet, which must still meet setbacks.
quote: A building permit is not required for the following: … One story detached accessory buildings that are accessory to a residential dwelling, used as tool and storage sheds, playhouses and similar uses provided the floor area does not exceed 200 square feet. Structure must still meet Setbacks & Offsets. Fences, other than swimming pool barriers). … Retaining walls which are not over four feet in height, measured from the bottom of the footings to the top of the wall … Sidewalks, patios and driveways not more than 30 inches above grade and not over any basement or story below. … Separate Plumbing, Electrical and Mechanical Permits may be required for exempted items.
source_label: Weld County Building Inspection Division, When is a Building Permit Needed? (bulletin footer 08/26; 2024 codes in all unincorporated Weld County)
notes: Applies in unincorporated Weld County, which includes Lake Arrowhead; inside Evans or Greeley the city building department governs.
